renderer: CYBR SCENES R2 / Drowned Geode: seepage mineral layers and weathered quartz
geometry_accelerator: CYBR GEO native SAH BVH4 / AVX2 triangle packets
spectral_method: Jointly transported fixed midpoint wavelength quadrature, 25 nm bins
steam_model: Bounded homogeneous haze; analytic transmittance; forced first collision; full continuation

sampling_v3.sampler: per-pixel digital shift over linearly scrambled 1024-dimensional Sobol nets
sampling_v3.water_camera_interface: both Fresnel reflection and transmission evaluated
sampling_v3.quartz_bsdf: GGX visible-normal dielectric with Fresnel reflection/transmission, matching PDF, spectral index and direct sun/sky NEE
sampling_v3.water_sky_nee: actual triangle interface, Snell refraction, Fresnel/absorption/scattering transmittance and MIS
sampling_v3.primary_haze: forced first collision, exact homogeneous transmittance, full continuation
sampling_v3.allocation: deterministic primary-material/depth allocation; no noisy stopping rule

finishing.method: symmetric log-variance, first-interface-aware component wavelet filtering; non-neural
